questions.q: After cameos in Superman's Pal Jimmy Olsen, in which comic did Darkseid make his first full appearance?
questions.why: Darkseid cameoed in Jimmy Olsen #134 in December 1970, then was fully introduced in Forever People #1 in February 1971.
Writer-artist Jack Kirby created Darkseid as the chief villain of his Fourth World saga.

questions.q: Darkseid is the tyrannical ruler of which planet?
questions.why: Darkseid is a New God who rules the hellish planet Apokolips.

questions.q: What are the eye blasts Darkseid fires called?
questions.why: His signature power is the Omega Effect, usually fired as Omega Beams from his eyes.

questions.q: What does Darkseid hunt for in order to enslave the multiverse and erase free will?
questions.why: He wants the Anti-Life Equation because it would let him dominate every living mind, ending hope and free will across the multiverse.

questions.q: Who played Darkseid in Zack Snyder's Justice League (2021)?
questions.why: Ray Porter voiced and performed Darkseid in Zack Snyder's cut, the character's live-action film debut.

questions.q: According to his creator, Darkseid's face was modeled on which actor?
questions.why: The artist based the stone-faced look on Palance, and drew on Hitler and Nixon for his personality.

questions.q: Darkseid is credited as the inspiration for which Marvel villain?
questions.why: Thanos's creators have said Kirby's Darkseid inspired him.

questions.q: In Final Crisis, which New God kills Darkseid by ripping out his heart?
questions.why: Orion, who is Darkseid's son, returns via boom tube and kills his father in their final battle.

questions.q: What was Darkseid's name before he took the title, when he was a prince of his home world?
questions.why: Born Prince Uxas, he schemed to take the throne from his older brother Drax and became Darkseid.
